title: A Day in the Park
setting: A green park on a cool spring day.

characters.name: Leo
characters.look: Leo, a tall boy with short brown hair

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia, a small girl in a red coat and a red hat

sentences.en: On Tuesday, Leo and Mia go to the park.
sentences.zh: 星期二，里奥和米娅去公园。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo, a tall boy with short brown hair and Mia, a small girl in a red coat and a red hat walk through the gate of a green park.

sentences.en: He is really tall, and Mia is small.
sentences.zh: 他个子真高，米娅却很小。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo, a tall boy with short brown hair stands next to Mia, a small girl in a red coat and a red hat; he is twice her height.

sentences.en: Mia wears a red coat and a hat.
sentences.zh: 米娅穿着红外套，戴着帽子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Close view of Mia, a small girl in a red coat and a red hat smiling in her red coat and red hat.

sentences.en: Their school has a fun activity there today.
sentences.zh: 他们学校今天在那里有一个有趣的活动。
sentences.scene_prompt: Children in sports clothes line up for a race on the park grass, a teacher in front.

sentences.en: Leo is fast, and Mia also runs quickly.
sentences.zh: 里奥跑得快，米娅也跑得很快。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo, a tall boy with short brown hair and Mia, a small girl in a red coat and a red hat race across the grass with other children.

sentences.en: Mia falls down and starts to cry.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a small girl in a red coat and a red hat sits on the grass crying, holding her knee.

sentences.en: Leo gives her a sandwich from his lunch.
sentences.zh: 里奥把午饭里的一块三明治给了她。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo, a tall boy with short brown hair kneels and offers Mia, a small girl in a red coat and a red hat a sandwich from his lunch box.

sentences.en: Soon nothing hurts, and she runs without crying.
sentences.zh: 很快就不疼了，她又跑了起来，不再哭了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a small girl in a red coat and a red hat runs again on the grass, smiling, Leo, a tall boy with short brown hair cheering beside her.
